coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 8 ground-truth variable items (25%): query direction (child-to-parent versus parent-to-child) and retrieval accuracy measured through correct answers and log-probabilities.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the IMDb/GPT-4 dataset with Wikidata-derived pairs and substitutes a different model lineup. Fixes temperature at zero rather than varying it by model or context. Question and cloze templates do not establish distinct chat-based and completion-based interaction modes. Does not specify the same fixed scripts for dataset creation, testing, and visualization. Uses McNemar tests and mixed models instead of the required t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied stating that child-to-parent retrieval outperforms parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse. Hypotheses within design_output do not constitute the missing conclusion_output.
